item.description: Woods reached the podium in all four of his seasons with the Mavericks and came back on Saturday to land his second straight bronze at 4A 190 pounds.

item.title: Broomfield’s Shayla Martinez remains perfect as she repeats as state wrestling champ
item.description: At the state tournament, she pinned everyone, sticking Loveland's Abigail Stearns in the exact same time as she did in last year's final — 63 seconds.

item.title: Mead’s Morgan McDonald places 4A state wrestling runner-up
item.description: In the immediate moments following a state championship loss, many wrestlers can be seen hanging their heads low, sometimes in tears. Mead’s Morgan McDonald was all smiles.

item.title: Colorado Buffs women’s basketball rallies past No. 20 Texas Tech
item.description: With the game on the line, the Colorado women’s basketball team cranked up its defense.

item.title: Holy Family’s Breezy Johnston finishes Class 4A state wrestling runner-up
item.description: Coming into her Class 4A, 125-pound state wrestling championship match at Ball Arena on Saturday night, Holy Family's Breezy Johnston was the girl who couldn't be tamed in the classification. She had only lost one match all year.

item.title: Monarch’s Benjamin Zelio shuts out Heritage in 5A first-round win
item.description: If Monarch is going to have a chance to get through the powers of 5A in the state hockey tournament, it'll likely need sensational goaltending.
